result.title: Change my password from Profile
result.acceptance:
**Expected behaviour** · Open Settings → Profile → Account, verify the current password, choose a new password and sign in again. Reuse the existing account-form controls.

**Verify** · A rejected change preserves the old login. A successful change revokes all prior sessions and the new password restores the same files and preferences.

**Delivery dependencies** · WI-061, WI-064

**Queue** · Follows WI-065 in the v0.3 delivery order.

**Target** · PI-03, v0.3.
